notes.title: Important Update Regarding Iris!
notes.content:
I’m excited to announce that I’ve completely changed Iris’s face! I liked the old design, but I really wanted to make it even better to give you the best possible experience. You can check out her new look in the attached screenshots. This new face will also be included in the demo that will be released very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972879/dbea142612af3680cad96a548307039d1b60b9b1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972879/912a90045cf2b457a08e160c603bedb41347104b.png[/img]

I’m counting on you to let me know what you think! Thank you for your support, and see you soon in the game!

notes.title: Gearing Up for 'Neo Fest' 2024: Sneak Peek of the Upcoming Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have just registered for Neo Fest in October 2024. I am in the process of finalizing the demo that you'll be able to try out at this festival.

In the meantime, here are a few images to get you excited about playing it.
(The images are still a work in progress and will be refined for the release. For example, post-production work has not yet been done.)

Thank you for Your support by adding the game to your wishlist makes all the difference!
